plugins.name: azure-devkit
plugins.description: A safer Azure copilot for Bicep, AKS, App Service, Functions, and RBAC reviews.

skills.name: aks-manifest
skills.description: Generate AKS-tailored Kubernetes manifests that use Azure Workload Identity, the Azure Key Vault CSI secret driver, and Application Gateway Ingress. Use when the user asks for AKS-specific YAML, asks to wire a pod to Key Vault, or asks for an Ingress using AGIC.
headings: Example: workload with Workload Identity, Key Vault CSI, and AGIC
Example: Workload Identity federated credential (reference only)
Example: AGIC with a hostname redirect
skills.description_zh: 生成适用于 Azure AKS 的 Kubernetes YAML，涵盖 Azure Workload Identity、Key Vault CSI 及 Application Gateway Ingress/AGIC 集成。

skills.name: app-service-deploy
skills.description: Generate an App Service deployment configuration and the az webapp up command to deploy. Use when the user asks to deploy a web app to Azure App Service, needs a web.config for Windows, a startup command for Linux, or wants a reproducible `az webapp up` invocation.
headings: Example output for a Node app on Linux
skills.description_zh: 配置并部署 Azure App Service 应用，使用 az webapp up，并处理 Windows web.config、Linux 启动配置及可复现的部署命令。

skills.name: az-debug
skills.description: Diagnose common Azure failures across AKS, App Service, and Azure Functions. Use when the user reports AKS pod errors, App Service startup failures or 502s, Functions cold starts, or Functions deployment errors.
skills.description_zh: 诊断 Azure AKS Pod、App Service 启动或 502 错误，以及 Azure Functions 冷启动和部署问题。

skills.name: bicep-template
skills.description: Generate idiomatic Bicep templates for common Azure resources. Use when the user asks to create a Bicep file for an App Service Plan and App Service, a Container App, a Storage Account, a Key Vault, a Cosmos DB account, or Application Insights.
headings: Example: App Service Plan and App Service
Example: Container App with managed environment
Example: Application Insights with Log Analytics workspace
skills.description_zh: 生成常见 Azure 资源的 Bicep 模板，涵盖 App Service 计划与应用、Container Apps、存储、Key Vault、Cosmos DB 和 Application Insights。

skills.name: functions-scaffold
skills.description: Scaffold an Azure Functions project with a handler and the right binding definition. Use when the user asks to create a new Azure Function, add an HTTP, Timer, Queue, or Blob trigger, or bootstrap a function in Node, Python, C#, or Java.
skills.description_zh: 为 Azure Functions 搭建 HTTP、定时器、队列或 Blob 触发器的处理程序与绑定，支持 Node.js、Python、C# 和 Java。

skills.name: rbac-azure-audit
skills.description: Audit Azure role assignments for overly broad permissions. Use when the user asks to review who has access to a subscription or resource group, flag Owner, Contributor, or User Access Administrator grants at subscription scope, or enforce least privilege on Azure RBAC.
headings: Step 5: enumerate assignments for a single principal
Confirm first. Dry-run by listing only:
After user approval, remove the specific assignment id:
skills.description_zh: 审查 Azure 订阅和资源组的 RBAC 授权是否符合最小权限原则，重点标记订阅层级的 Owner、Contributor 和 User Access Administrator 权限。

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the local Azure toolchain. Reports az CLI version, active subscription and tenant, Bicep CLI version, Azure Functions Core Tools version, and kubectl context if AKS is in use. Use before running any Azure skill to confirm the environment is ready.

commands.name: full-audit
commands.description: Run the full Azure audit pass in one command. Chains doctor, whoami, and rbac-azure-audit into a single report. Use as a pre-release or pre-handoff check to surface environment, identity, and access findings in one pass.

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Show the current Azure identity, active subscription and tenant, and available subscriptions. Use before any operation that changes cloud state so the user confirms they are pointing at the right subscription. Does not change state.
headings: Who am I in Azure right now?
About ZIP files and the Claude app
